summary: You can install SecurityInsight unattended with one command, and resume it if it stops.

new.title: Install with one command
new.text: Every setting of the guided install is now an option on one command, so the install runs unattended and reports each step. Only the tenant and subscription are required.

new.title: Install before you have a licence
new.text: The install deploys the whole environment without a licence and runs nothing paid until one is assigned. It then takes its licence by itself.

new.title: Continue a stopped install
new.text: If an install stops, you continue it with the same command and the Resume option.
